goal: 交付 https://www.chickenbro.cloud 的桌面优先 Web/H5 登录原型：浏览器生成一次性二维码，Chickenbro 小程序扫码并明确确认，Web 建立独立 HttpOnly Cookie 会话。
userValue: 用户可以从电脑 Web 入口安全连接自己的微信账户，并在不共享小程序凭据的前提下进入后续炸鸡队长与 SimC 工作台入口。

typed Web credential transport and H5 Web shell
no-TabBar mini-program Web login confirmation route
isolated wow-v2-api, www Nginx site and backup-first candidate deploy entry

evidenceRequired: focused v2 Python, typed client and Taro route tests
H5 and WeApp production builds plus auxiliary-route architecture checks
candidate commit/build identity, PostgreSQL backup, migration, Nginx and endpoint smoke
real QR scan, mini-program confirmation, Cookie refresh, logout and replay/expiry recovery
privacy-safe logs with no secret, token, OpenID, UnionID, Cookie or full scene payload

identityConstraint.browserVerifier: high-entropy sessionStorage value; only SHA-256 is persisted server-side
identityConstraint.sceneTicket: opaque short-lived single-use value with no personal fields

engineeringHealth.reason: The local code/build ladder passes and the H5 shell renders without a Taro error overlay; candidate promotion is blocked by missing v2 configuration and invalid www TLS coverage.

acceptanceEvidence: The public Web root renders a real Web login shell without the old four-tab navigation.
A successful create response returns a non-placeholder PNG QR whose scene is opaque and not an identity payload.
The QR opens the no-TabBar mini-program confirmation page, which requires an explicit user click before binding the Web session.
Web status changes are backend-owned pending -> confirmed -> authenticated, and exchange issues an independent HttpOnly Cookie.
Refresh, logout, expiry, cancellation, verifier mismatch and repeated exchange recover with stable public states; /api/v2/me returns only safe user view.
Legacy service/API/Manifest/14 product routes remain untouched, and logs/evidence contain no sensitive credentials or identity values.

decisionLog.decision: The user authorized inline implementation, dependency installation and direct progression to the public Web prototype.

Use the existing Taro/React workspace with an H5-only shell, an auxiliary no-TabBar mini-program confirmation page, independent v2 Web Cookie and mini Bearer sessions, and an isolated candidate service.
Do not claim public login completion while v2 env, WeChat configuration, www TLS coverage or physical QR confirmation evidence is absent.
